import Submission
import Lean
set_option maxRecDepth 4000000
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
open Lean Meta Elab in
run_meta do
  let implC := Lean.mkConst ``Submission.impl
  let lhs := Lean.mkApp implC (Lean.mkNatLit 5)
  let out ← whnf (← inferType implC).bindingBody!
  let outIsInt := out.isConstOf ``Int
  unless outIsInt || out.isConstOf ``Nat do
    throwError "unsupported impl output type {out}"
  let rhs := if outIsInt then Lean.mkApp (Lean.mkConst ``Int.ofNat) (Lean.mkNatLit 0) else Lean.mkNatLit 0
  let ty ← mkEq lhs rhs
  let pf ← mkEqRefl rhs
  Lean.addDecl (.thmDecl {
    name := `LeanKernelChallengeJudge.Generated_50b89c92eb153a9ce9b2139f.check,
    levelParams := [],
    type := ty,
    value := pf })
